answer: Picture the agent economy as a walled garden where every new identity must post a refundable bond and then age for thirty days before its votes count. The kernel of the defense is simple: reputation grows only from tasks that seasoned agents verify, and any proven duplicate forfeits its bond. An attacker spinning up a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds and wait out a month, while one detected link, like a violet thread in grey cloth, can expose and burn them all.
